Subject: Final true-up and wiring instructions for renewal (ProspectCo / DEAL-4872)

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks for the renewal walk-through last week. Finance here has one consolidated ask so we can close our books: we need the final true-up invoice and clear wire routing so Accounts Payable can accept the payment and apply the credit. Also — because some of the usage fell into the EU legal entity, we need your VAT declaration (or confirmation of export status) to support our reclaim.

Can you confirm:
- Final invoice (PDF) with line-level true-up and original PO reference PO-98123
- Preferred wiring beneficiary and euro IBAN / SWIFT (or a EUR SEPA option)
- VAT declaration or certificate for 2026/2027 to attach to our tax files
- Expected payment terms (wire received by, or net days)

If you can share the invoice and routing by EOD Thursday (20 May) we can get sign-off and route payment through our collections partner.

Best,
Elena Morales
Head of Finance Operations
ProspectCo

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. We can definitely get that done. Quick notes before I circulate the final PDF:

- I will generate the final true-up invoice that includes the original PO-98123 reference and the line-level usage adjustments.
- For payment routing we offer two options: EUR SEPA to our Luxembourg settlement account or international wire to Redwood Ltd. (GBP/EUR). I will include both sets of details on the invoice stub so AP can pick.
- VAT: because part of the usage maps to your EU entity, I've asked tax to produce a VAT declaration/certificate confirming the place of supply and our VAT handling for 2026–27. That will be attached.
- Payment terms: standard is net 30 from invoice date; if your collections partner requires a quicker cutoff we can accept wire confirmation and mark as received the day funds settle into our account.

Marissa / Karthik — looping you in for the invoice and to confirm the invoice file name convention we discussed (RI_FINAL_TRUEUP_INVOICE_4872.pdf) and whether finance needs any extra spreadsheet with token-level charges.

I'll share the invoice + VAT doc by Thursday morning CET.

Thanks,

Nikhil — noted. Quick checklist from finance side so the external invoice doesn't bounce:

- Invoice PDF must include: invoice number, invoice date, due date, PO-98123, breakdown (base subscription vs true-up tokens), VAT amount shown separately, our registered VAT number, and beneficiary bank details.
- Bank details: include both SEPA (IBAN) and SWIFT/IBAN for non-SEPA routing. Make sure the beneficiary name matches the bank record (Redwood Inference Luxembourg SARL).
- Attach VAT declaration (signed by tax) and a short cover note confirming tax residency handling.
- If they need immediate payment posting, we can accept a copy of the wire confirmation and book date as received once cleared.

Karthik — can you confirm the exact beneficiary strings and the ledger reference we should include? Laura, FYI so CS can update the renewal record with final invoice data.

Marissa Cole

3) If you can include a short breakdown CSV that maps token buckets to the line items on the invoice, that helps our ERPs match automatically.

We expect to route payment the week of 24 May once we have the invoice and VAT doc.

Regards,
